Anatomy Ballistics — copy & paste / drop into Codea
==================================================

EASIEST (recommended)
---------------------
1. Unzip this archive.
2. Open the Files app on your iPad.
3. Copy the folder named:

      AnatomyBallistics.codea

   into:

      On My iPad → Codea

4. Open the Codea app.
5. Tap AnatomyBallistics → Play (landscape).


MANUAL PASTE (if drop does not work)
------------------------------------
1. Open Codea → + → New Project → name it AnatomyBallistics
2. Open each file in lua-buffers-for-paste/ in order:

   01_Main.lua        → paste into buffer Main
   02_Vec3.lua        → add buffer Vec3, paste
   03_TwentyTwo.lua   → add buffer TwentyTwo, paste
   04_Bones.lua       → add buffer Bones, paste
   05_Organs.lua      → add buffer Organs, paste
   06_Stages.lua      → add buffer Stages, paste
   07_Ballistics.lua  → add buffer Ballistics, paste
   08_SoftBody.lua    → add buffer SoftBody, paste
   09_Blood.lua       → add buffer Blood, paste
   10_Anatomy.lua     → add buffer Anatomy, paste
   11_Camera.lua      → add buffer Camera, paste

3. Project Info → Buffer Order must match the list above
   (or copy Info.plist from AnatomyBallistics.codea).

4. Play.


CONTROLS
--------
Drag = aim   Double-tap = fire (.22 LR, 3s cooldown)
RESET = rebuild body   NEXT = closer range / wall stage
